_comment: Issue #1765, re-judged for #1949: a cavalry troop that breaks from a contagion flees and rallies without its men riding through each other, and re-forms where they come to rest. Player Cavalry (uid 0, 18 horses on 5 files: 3 full ranks and a 3-horse short rank) starts facing south at (700, 500) and is quarter-turned right (E) at tick 12, so it faces west. A weak Infantry company (uid 1, 8 men) stands south of it. The enemy Cavalry (uid 2) charges the company, which breaks at tick 169; the contagion (12 morale off every friend within 140 wu) breaks the troop too, and uid 0 reads ROUTING from tick 170. Each routed man runs north on his own (SoldierFlightStep), the troop rallies at tick 531 near the field's north edge, its men pull up on their own at their braking rate, and it re-forms where they come to rest: its grid is laid out at their centroid and each man is dealt the place nearest where he stands. Measured with dense 2-tick FULL dumps on seeds 0 to 4, 2026-11-13 on #1949's branch: no two of the troop's men stand within a body radius of each other at the break (ticks 170 and 172), at the rally (tick 531), or while they pull up and re-form (tick 700) (pairs_within_body_radius 0, pinned). From tick 760 on seeds 1 to 3 the troop, far from any enemy, drops to the far tier, which has no bodies to read, so no later tick is pinned. #1765's pins read the slot grid: slots_across_centreline 0 and slot_lateral_excess 0 (tol 0.5 or 1.0 wu) at ticks 170, 172, 531, 864 and 1080, claiming that the rout moved no slot and that the rally re-squared the fold in depth only. The bottom-up flight (#1949) removed the slot a routed man would keep and the fold and re-square the rally undid, so those eight pins are retired for the pairs_within_body_radius pins, which fail for a flight or a re-form that sends men through each other. The follow_error exemption for uids 0 and 2 is dropped: on seeds 0 to 4 uid 0 reads under 0.001 wu now that the scan no longer judges a rallied unit's shape while its men pull up from their flight, and uid 2, the enemy cavalry, reads at most 9.6 wu against 30 now that its riders chase the runners man by man and are not judged for shape while they do. The clip ends at tick 1100.
